name: ActionReadout
label: Action readout
description: What a confirmed change did: a title over a list of facts, worked out from the records as they were just before it.

props.name: title
props.description: What was done, with how much: "69 orders cancelled". Collides with the native `title` tooltip attribute on purpose: the readout shows it.

props.name: facts
props.description: What it did, a line each: the status it moved, the money it touched, who it reached.

props.name: icon
props.description: A leading mark beside the title: a Material Symbol name, or your own element.

ActionReadoutFact.description: One line of a readout: what it measures and its value, already written in the reader's locale.
